summary: W. R. Berkley Corp filed an 8-K reporting the passing of founder and Executive Chairman William R. Berkley. The Board immediately appointed President/CEO W. Robert Berkley Jr. as Chairman. This is a leadership succession event triggered by death, not a forced departure. No financial terms, price, premium, or deal mechanics are involved. The filing is an obituary-style disclosure of a natural transition. Watch for any secondary strategic impact; no risk-arb angle.
